purpose: Reusable build-time procedures for the acquisition and document-evidence product increment; capability specifications are not completion claims.

scope_boundary.included: Document provenance, reviewed-input workflows, existing finance and deal engines, probability evaluation, CUDA design, R validation, interfaces, connectors, assurance, later AI adapters, and release operations.
scope_boundary.excluded_from_this_increment: Full implementation of all 338 master requirements, new property strategies, live provider deployments, actual transactions, trained predictive models, and autonomous product agents.
scope_boundary.capability_state_rule: Each capability is specified. Change its delivery_state only with source, test, runtime, and review evidence for that capability.
scope_boundary.scale_goal: Future goal: serve two million U.S. households, including immigrants. The initial segment, participant incentive, payer/revenue model, accessibility/localization, representative workload and unit economics require validation before scale.
scope_boundary.professional_rigor: Wall Street-level rigor is a validation target; this catalog and prototype do not establish institutional readiness or approval.

runtime_policy.builder_swarm: active development method; temporary builders produce code, tests, contracts, and guides
runtime_policy.skills: reusable development instructions; installing a skill does not deploy a runtime process
runtime_policy.product_core: ordinary deterministic code plus explicitly supplied probability assumptions
runtime_policy.nvidia_document_services: later optional adapters; not required by the default product
runtime_policy.R_runtime: must be observed and dependency-locked before claiming executed integration
runtime_policy.CUDA_runtime: explicit backend; availability, parity, and speed claims require real hardware evidence
runtime_policy.builder_scheduler: offline planning tool; does not launch agents, call services, or run inside the product

agent_roles.responsibility: Own boundaries, shared contracts, task allocation, application integration, review experience, and truthful delivery status.
Own document identity, immutable claims, source review, accepted inputs, connector boundaries, and disabled future AI interfaces.
Own authoritative financial semantics, conditional probability calculations, scenario policies, and CUDA batch design.
Own independent checks, R exchange/reproducibility, failure cases, release evidence, operational observability, and recovery.

skills.name: br-build-product
skills.description: Plan, integrate, and verify changes to the Black River acquisition product. Use for product architecture, builder-swarm work allocation, engine-before-layer sequencing, and resolving cross-component boundaries.
scope_now: Map requirements to existing code and tests.
Define component contracts and allocate isolated builder tasks.
Integrate a deterministic evidence-to-underwriting demonstration.
scope_future: Expand the validated foundation to additional strategies and operating products.
Evaluate optional product AI only after the non-AI workflow is stable.

capabilities.action: Record the product and builder boundary
capabilities.input: User objective, session instructions, AGENTS.md, current architecture
capabilities.output: Versioned boundary decision naming build-time agents and product runtime components
capabilities.acceptance: The ordinary product path runs without an LLM, autonomous agent, or NVIDIA model service; later AI is explicitly disabled.

capabilities.input: Repository revision, maintained source map, tests, available runtimes
capabilities.output: Capability-to-code-and-test inventory with observed limitations
capabilities.acceptance: Reuse working finance, ledger, storage, and workflow modules; distinguish source-reviewed, executed, and planned behavior.

capabilities.input: Business workflow, initial service segment, customer need, participant incentive, payer/revenue hypothesis, unresolved gaps, and acceptance constraints
capabilities.output: Initial-segment and unit-economics hypotheses plus a dependency-ordered work breakdown with stable capability IDs
capabilities.acceptance: Select an initial segment using service need, geography, obtainable evidence, and delivery capacity; state the participant incentive, payer, revenue/cost hypothesis, and validation measure. Every work item has an owner, inputs, outputs, completion evidence, and an explicit phase. The two-million-household goal remains an unproven scale hypothesis.

capabilities.input: Evidence records, monetary types, identifiers, time conventions
capabilities.output: Versioned contract for engines, application services, and adapters
capabilities.acceptance: IDs, currency, units, dates, null semantics, rounding, and error behavior are explicit and can be validated without AI.

capabilities.input: Shared contracts, permitted files, builder roles
capabilities.output: Disjoint work assignments and integration record
capabilities.acceptance: Concurrent builders have bounded ownership; dependencies and conflicts are resolved sequentially by the integrator.

capabilities.input: Diff, test results, interface examples, known gaps
capabilities.output: Release summary with implemented, tested, deferred, and blocked sections
capabilities.acceptance: No planned capability, unavailable R/CUDA execution, or future AI service is reported as deployed.

steps: Read current instructions, inspect the existing implementation, and state the precise business workflow.
Assign engine ownership and freeze the smallest shared interface before parallel edits.
Dispatch builders with disjoint files and acceptance conditions; collect their artifacts rather than votes.
Integrate, reproduce the material success and failure paths, and report actual execution boundaries.
failure_modes: Turning builder agents into production dependencies.
Duplicating authoritative financial rules across layers.
Treating a plan or configuration file as a deployed service.
example_prompts: Build the document evidence engine first and integrate its reviewed inputs into underwriting.
Deploy a builder swarm for the next Black River increment while keeping product AI disabled.

skills.name: br-build-evidence-engine
skills.description: Build deterministic document provenance, immutable claims, review decisions, and accepted-input projections for Black River. Use when source identity, version history, review status, or evidence freshness affects a financial or workflow decision.
scope_now: Register document identity and source provenance.
Store typed candidate claims and explicit review events.
Project current accepted evidence with blockers.
scope_future: Add richer custody, source signatures, retention policies, and production storage.
Support additional evidence kinds using the same review boundary.

capabilities.input: Deal ID, document ID, source reference, content hash, version, observation date
capabilities.output: Document registration record bound to one deal and version
capabilities.acceptance: Duplicate IDs cannot replace different content; malformed hashes and missing provenance are rejected.

capabilities.input: Document registration, page or structured location, extracted text or value
capabilities.output: Typed claim with a source locator and currency or physical unit
capabilities.acceptance: Page references are valid for the source type; money is not silently converted between dollars and cents.

capabilities.input: Old and new source versions with an explicit relationship
capabilities.output: Append-only version lineage and current-source determination
capabilities.acceptance: Old sources remain reproducible; a later upload alone does not silently erase previously reviewed evidence.

capabilities.input: Claim ID, reviewer, decision, review time, rationale
capabilities.output: Immutable acceptance, rejection, or conflict review event
capabilities.acceptance: Candidate claims cannot self-approve; review cannot silently alter the source value or deal binding.

capabilities.input: Claims, reviews, effective and expiry dates, analysis date
capabilities.output: Current evidence set with stale, superseded, contradictory, and missing flags
capabilities.acceptance: Future or expired evidence cannot enter the projection; two incompatible accepted current values remain a blocker.

capabilities.input: Deal ID, analysis date, current reviewed claims, expected field schema
capabilities.output: Deterministic fact projection, source links, and blocking reasons
capabilities.acceptance: Wrong-deal, ambiguous, unreviewed, or incompatible-unit claims cannot become financial inputs; the projection is reproducible.

steps: Specify the document, claim, and review contracts before adding a storage implementation.
Keep source content and candidate claims immutable; append review and supersession history.
Evaluate identity, time, units, review status, and contradictory evidence when projecting inputs.
Reproduce the same projection from stored events and exercise a stale or conflicting case.
failure_modes: Overwriting a prior claim to simulate a correction.
Using an OCR score as a review decision.
Losing source version or page identity during normalization.
example_prompts: Build an evidence store that blocks expired and contradictory renovation estimates.
Add immutable document versions and source-linked review decisions.

skills.name: br-build-document-workflows
skills.description: Build non-AI document intake and application workflows around the Black River evidence engine. Use for native file parsing, manual claim entry, reconciliation queues, accepted-input mapping, and evidence change propagation.
scope_now: Accept structured JSON or explicit manual-entry candidate claims.
Route missing or conflicting values to review.
Apply accepted values through a versioned underwriting input map.
scope_future: Add tested native PDF, spreadsheet, CSV, and email intake by source type.
Introduce assisted extraction only through the later AI adapter contract.

capabilities.action: Define intake manifests and duplicate behavior
capabilities.input: Authorized files, content fingerprints, MIME or source types, deal scope
capabilities.output: Intake manifest with candidate, duplicate, unsupported, and error states
capabilities.acceptance: Reprocessing identical input is idempotent; corrupt or unsupported files remain visible without guessed content.

capabilities.input: Manual entries or deterministic parser output, source-location metadata
capabilities.output: Provider-neutral candidate-claim envelope
capabilities.acceptance: The envelope preserves raw values and provenance; absent fields remain missing and do not become zero.

capabilities.input: Candidate rent, cost, fee, balance, period, and unit fields
capabilities.output: Reconciliation findings tied to the affected claim IDs
capabilities.acceptance: Totals, period alignment, units, and source conflicts are checked with declared rules and no invented balancing amounts.

capabilities.input: Candidate claims, reconciliation findings, named operator action
capabilities.output: Reviewed evidence projection or explicit hold
capabilities.acceptance: Only valid state transitions create reviews; unresolved source conflicts cannot bypass the evidence engine.

capabilities.action: Map reviewed fields into model inputs
capabilities.input: Accepted evidence projection, binding map, model input version
capabilities.output: New underwriting packet plus changed-field provenance
capabilities.acceptance: Only permitted fields and scenarios are changed; evidence values never silently replace probability assumptions.

capabilities.action: Propagate evidence changes to downstream decisions
capabilities.input: Previous and current projection digest, affected model runs and reviews
capabilities.output: Invalidation and recomputation record with retained prior results
capabilities.acceptance: A changed material input cannot reuse an approval for an old packet; the old result remains inspectable.

steps: Choose the least lossy intake method for the actual source type and retain the original artifact.
Convert every parser result into candidate claims, not approved facts.
Reconcile, collect explicit review decisions, and project accepted inputs.
Apply only the declared field bindings and preserve a before-and-after calculation trace.
failure_modes: Treating spreadsheet text extraction as a substitute for values and formulas.
Applying one quote change to every stochastic scenario without an explicit rule.
Advancing a transaction merely because a document contains a signature.
example_prompts: Connect a reviewed contractor quote to the baseline renovation input and invalidate the old decision.
Build a manual document-review queue without an OCR or LLM dependency.

skills.name: br-build-financial-engine
skills.description: Implement or extend authoritative acquisition economics, cash requirements, valuation, financing, and reconciliation in Black River. Use when financial formulas, monetary precision, reserves, cost treatment, or binding price limits change.
scope_now: Reuse existing authoritative financial modules.
Expose formula inputs, intermediate amounts, and policy limits.
Distinguish expenses, reserves, cash balances, and receipts.
scope_future: Extend strategy-specific operating and financing schedules.
Add portfolio, development, tax, and cross-currency scope only with explicit models and evidence.

capabilities.input: Currency, integer cents or declared numeric type, rounding and dates
capabilities.output: Validated money and period contract
capabilities.acceptance: Boolean, nonfinite, missing, overflow, and incompatible currency/unit inputs fail explicitly.

capabilities.input: Purchase, sale, operating, renovation, closing, financing, and reserve assumptions
capabilities.output: Reconciled profit and cost trace
capabilities.acceptance: Every cost is counted once; refundable deposits and unspent reserves are distinguished from consumed expenses.

capabilities.input: Joint economic scenarios, offer terms, existing financial engine outputs
capabilities.output: Per-offer and per-scenario profit and liquidity requirements
capabilities.acceptance: Dependencies within each case are preserved; acquisition cash, terminal profit, and dated returns are labeled separately.

capabilities.input: Baseline, downside, expected-return, liquidity, and financing policies
capabilities.output: Named price ceilings and failed constraints
capabilities.acceptance: The strictest applicable constraint is visible; higher seller acceptance never silently relaxes a financial rule.

capabilities.input: Verified financing terms, dated forecasts, rate and debt schedules
capabilities.output: Debt service, funding gap, valuation, and return calculations
capabilities.acceptance: Loan proceeds and principal repayments reconcile; IRR/NPV claims require correctly dated cash-flow definitions.

capabilities.input: Approved packet, obligations, invoices, receipts, ledger entries
capabilities.output: Variance bridge and realized cash reconciliation
capabilities.acceptance: A billed amount is not a cash receipt; corrections preserve original postings and use explicit adjusting evidence.

steps: Locate and reuse the authoritative financial implementation and its rounding conventions.
Write the complete sources-and-uses or cost bridge before optimizing.
Expose intermediate calculations and separate policy thresholds from valuation estimates.
Check a worked case and a material failure such as a duplicated cost, funding gap, or changed financing term.
failure_modes: Counting a reserve both as spent cost and retained capital.
Confusing expected profit per attempt with profit conditional on closing.
Creating a conflicting production formula set in R or the UI.
example_prompts: Add a fully traced renovation and carrying-cost bridge to the acquisition engine.
Reconcile final closing costs and receipts against the approved purchase model.

skills.name: br-build-probability-engine
skills.description: Build conditional offer, closing, and investment-outcome models with exact reference calculations and explicit uncertainty. Use for expected pursuit value, chance constraints, seller-counter conditioning, sensitivity, and later probability calibration.
scope_now: Evaluate explicit joint scenario assumptions and one-round event trees.
Separate baseline, expected-conditional, and chance constraints.
Make missing or hypothetical probabilities visible.
scope_future: Estimate probabilities from complete timestamped outcomes.
Model multi-round negotiations and correlated portfolio outcomes after validation.

capabilities.input: Current negotiation state, offer version, observation window, economic scope
capabilities.output: Event definitions for agreement, closing, and post-acquisition profit
capabilities.acceptance: Every probability has a denominator and horizon; an existing live counter is distinguished from a fresh offer.

capabilities.input: Scenario IDs, probability weights, conditional financial outcomes
capabilities.output: Exact CPU weighted moments and target/loss probabilities
capabilities.acceptance: Weights sum to one; dependencies between sale prices and costs are represented jointly rather than silently assumed independent.

capabilities.input: Agreement and conditional closing assumptions, branch-total costs, profit distribution
capabilities.output: Terminal states, mass check, expected cash per attempt
capabilities.acceptance: Branches are mutually exclusive and exhaustive; failed-pursuit costs are deducted once and unknown acceptance stays unknown.

capabilities.input: Profit distribution, baseline threshold, expected threshold, chance requirement
capabilities.output: Eligibility results and labeled price ceilings
capabilities.acceptance: Conditional and unconditional criteria are never interchanged; discrete chance boundaries are checked directly.

capabilities.action: Evaluate decision sensitivity and continuation limits
capabilities.input: Probability ranges, shared-terms assumptions, one-round action set
capabilities.output: Switching thresholds, coherent parameter sweep, limitation record
capabilities.acceptance: Assumption ranges are not confidence intervals; grid-cell counts are not probabilities that a strategy is best; multi-round claims require transitions.

capabilities.action: Design and validate empirical probability models
capabilities.input: All timestamped offers and outcomes, predictor cutoff, pending cases
capabilities.output: Time-separated evaluation, calibration, proper scores, uncertainty and model card
capabilities.acceptance: Use only information available at prediction time; handle pending/censored cases and related-deal leakage; no calibrated claim without evaluation evidence.

steps: Define events, horizons, and the exact current offer/counter state.
Reproduce the conditional financial distribution with exact CPU arithmetic.
Build terminal branch values, then apply hard policy gates before ranking eligible actions.
Use switching thresholds and sensitivity first; fit probability models only when adequate outcome data exists.
failure_modes: Averaging agent votes into seller acceptance probabilities.
Double-counting pursuit expenses in terminal states.
Treating repeated counters as independent retries or calling a grid share confidence.
example_prompts: Evaluate the duplex offers using explicit acceptance and closing assumptions.
Compute the acceptance improvement needed to justify paying another $2,000.

skills.name: br-build-deal-workflow
skills.description: Build evidence-gated deal states, independent buyable/fundable/sellable checks, review authority, and cash-cycle progression. Use when negotiation, contract, closing, operation, exit, or settlement states and their transitions are changed.
scope_now: Keep deal status separate from documents and model scores.
Preserve scoped review, immutable packets, and idempotent transitions.
Connect evidence changes to existing transaction controls.
scope_future: Extend strategy-specific contract, closing, operating, and exit stages.
Add real transaction integrations only with explicit authority and verified evidence.

capabilities.input: Deal identity and current acquisition, capital, and exit evidence
capabilities.output: Buyable, fundable, and sellable statuses with unknown/blocked reasons
capabilities.acceptance: Passing one dimension never substitutes for the evidence needed by another.

capabilities.input: Versioned stage vocabulary, events, actors, dates, and prerequisites
capabilities.output: State-transition specification from discovery through exit
capabilities.acceptance: Extraction and inference cannot directly advance agreement, closing, ownership, or cash-settlement status.

capabilities.action: Bind decisions to exact evidence packets
capabilities.input: Current input digest, model version, reviewer identity, permitted action
capabilities.output: Review decision tied to one immutable packet
capabilities.acceptance: Changed material inputs invalidate the prior review; scope, role, and review separation are checked.

capabilities.input: Idempotency keys, current revision, transaction boundary, task lease
capabilities.output: At-most-once recorded transition and recoverable processing state
capabilities.acceptance: Concurrent or repeated requests cannot duplicate a financial effect or silently approve a stale revision.

capabilities.action: Separate proposals from externally consequential actions
capabilities.input: Prepared offer, dispatch request, signing or funding action, explicit authority
capabilities.output: Action-specific execution boundary and audit trail
capabilities.acceptance: A builder or simulation cannot send offers, sign documents, move funds, or claim ownership without a separately authorized execution path.

capabilities.action: Track completion, operation, exit, and reinvestment
capabilities.input: Contract/closing evidence, obligations, receipts, operating events, exit records
capabilities.output: Reconciled lifecycle history and capital allocation inputs
capabilities.acceptance: Only independently evidenced receipts become realized cash; living-expense or reinvestment allocations preserve obligations and reserves.

steps: Model the business event and evidence prerequisites before editing status fields.
Keep buyability, fundability, exit feasibility, and financial policy independent.
Bind each proposed action to the exact evidence and model revision.
Exercise stale-state, retry, concurrency, and reconciliation failures before enabling a transition.
failure_modes: Equating an uploaded signed-looking page with a completed legal transaction.
Treating a model recommendation as execution authority.
Counting projected sale proceeds as available cash.
example_prompts: Add a negotiation state transition that cannot bypass financing or source review.
Track acquisition through actual receipts and reinvestment without double-counting cash.

skills.name: br-build-cuda-compute
skills.description: Design and verify efficient CUDA batches for Black River finance and analytics while preserving a readable CPU reference. Use for GPU backends, memory bounds, precision parity, profiling, batching, and R-originated accelerated workloads.
scope_now: Batch independent offers and scenarios; retain sequential financial dependencies.
Make explicit CUDA requests fail visibly when unavailable.
Record actual execution and comparison evidence.
scope_future: Tune device-resident services and measured concurrency on supported hardware.
Add multi-GPU execution only for demonstrated workloads.

capabilities.input: Profiled workload, dependency graph, input volume and device capabilities
capabilities.output: CPU/GPU partition with workload justification
capabilities.acceptance: Parallelize independent cases; preserve within-case financial order; retain tiny or irregular control work on CPU with reasons.

capabilities.input: Typed arrays, case IDs, precision contract, memory and arithmetic limits
capabilities.output: Versioned batch input/output contract and chunk policy
capabilities.acceptance: Shape, length, identifiers, finite values, overflow and maximum allocation are checked before execution.

capabilities.input: Validated batches, explicit device/backend selection, CPU reference
capabilities.output: Vectorized or fused GPU operation with allocation reuse
capabilities.acceptance: Avoid per-record transfers and repeated model/kernel initialization; explicit CUDA failures never silently become CPU execution.

capabilities.input: CPU reference, GPU outputs, threshold cases, rounding rules
capabilities.output: Exact or tolerance-justified comparison report
capabilities.acceptance: Money and eligibility decisions match declared semantics; tolerance is meaningful in currency units and tested at policy boundaries.

capabilities.input: Actual device, environment, cold/warm runs, transfers and synchronization
capabilities.output: Reproducible throughput, latency, memory, and error measurements
capabilities.acceptance: Every speedup names hardware, workload, precision, baseline, warmup and transfer scope; no speedup is inferred from utilization alone.

capabilities.input: Python service and planned R exchange, shared batch API
capabilities.output: Consistent backend metadata and minimal-return execution path
capabilities.acceptance: R and application callers invoke the same financial backend; results report actual execution and have stable case ordering.

steps: Measure or characterize the work and define a bounded batch contract.
Keep the exact or high-precision CPU path as the semantic reference.
Implement reusable device operations and minimize transfers without changing formulas.
Verify correctness first, then benchmark on actual hardware with explicit unavailable results when no GPU exists.
failure_modes: Claiming CUDA execution from code inspection.
Using reduced financial precision solely to increase utilization.
Measuring kernel-only time while excluding required transfers or startup.
example_prompts: Add a CUDA probability sweep that reproduces the exact CPU example.
Profile an R-to-Python GPU batch while preserving cents and source IDs.

skills.name: br-build-r-validation
skills.description: Design and implement R statistical research and independent validation against Black River's authoritative Python engines. Use for typed exchanges, R runtime reproducibility, calibration, survival analysis, diagnostics, and numerical parity.
scope_now: Specify a versioned R/Python exchange and independent worked-case checks.
Keep R execution unavailable until a real runtime and dependency lock are verified.
Separate statistical research outputs from production decision authority.
scope_future: Create and test an actual renv-managed R project.
Add calibration, econometrics, survival and reporting workflows after data and runtime readiness.

capabilities.action: Establish reproducible R and Python environments
capabilities.input: Actual installed R, renv packages, Python environment, device requirements
capabilities.output: Generated dependency lock, runtime manifest, restore procedure
capabilities.acceptance: Do not fabricate a renv lock or successful run; record actual R/Python versions and independently verify restoration.

capabilities.input: Versioned case, source, offer and scenario records with currency and dates
capabilities.output: Arrow/Parquet or validated interchange schema and conversion rules
capabilities.acceptance: Cents, nulls, IDs, dates/time zones and array order round-trip without lossy implicit conversion.

capabilities.input: Known financial cases and explicit outcome distributions
capabilities.output: R results compared with Python reference at declared tolerances
capabilities.acceptance: The check is independently expressed and executed; it does not become a competing authoritative production engine.

capabilities.action: Evaluate calibration and economic forecast loss
capabilities.input: Versioned historical predictions, observed outcomes, evaluation cutoff
capabilities.output: Reliability plots, proper scores, sample counts and economic-loss diagnostics
capabilities.acceptance: Out-of-sample evaluation excludes future information; uncertainty and thin samples remain explicit.

capabilities.input: Negotiation/closing event dates, current status, censoring rules
capabilities.output: Time-to-event analysis with declared event and risk-set definitions
capabilities.acceptance: Pending cases are not mislabeled failures; competing outcomes and observation windows are represented explicitly.

capabilities.input: Pinned inputs, model versions, diagnostics, execution manifest
capabilities.output: Traceable statistical report and discrepancy register
capabilities.acceptance: Every result resolves to data and executable analysis; unexecuted R/CUDA paths are explicitly marked.

steps: Check runtime availability and generate environment locks only from a real installation.
Choose an explicit typed exchange and bind the intended Python environment before imports.
Run small independent financial checks before adding statistical diagnostics.
Preserve model/data versions, uncertainty, and execution status in every report.
failure_modes: Passing large monetary integers through an unchecked double conversion.
Claiming base R automatically uses CUDA.
Calling a source-reviewed R script an executed validation.
example_prompts: Create an R validation contract for the exact offer probability engine.
Add survival analysis for open negotiations after collecting complete event histories.

skills.name: br-build-review-interface
skills.description: Build understandable operator interfaces around existing Black River services. Use for source-to-number traces, evidence review, offer comparisons, policy controls, responsive accessibility, and explicit execution/status displays.
scope_now: Specify interfaces that expose current evidence, inputs, formulas, and blockers.
Connect a bounded interface only after engine/service contracts are stable.
Preserve source-linked explanations and clear unknown states.
scope_future: Implement broader review queues, document side-by-side review, and responsive dashboards.
Add assistive AI explanations later without relocating financial formulas into prompts.

capabilities.input: Accepted inputs, source locators, model trace, changed-field list
capabilities.output: Inspect input/source/formula/output navigation
capabilities.acceptance: An operator can explain one output and locate its source without relying on a generated narrative.

capabilities.input: Claim states, review findings, stale sources, required fields
capabilities.output: Prioritized review queue with explicit actions and reasons
capabilities.acceptance: Unknown, zero, rejected, expired and conflicting values remain visually and semantically distinct.

capabilities.input: Baseline/expected/chance constraints, capital requirements, current values
capabilities.output: Labeled policy editor and eligible-action comparison
capabilities.acceptance: Changing a control records a new input version and visibly changes the affected policy output; no hidden relaxation occurs.

capabilities.action: Render complete offer and outcome comparisons
capabilities.input: Offer economics, agreement/closing assumptions, terminal outcomes
capabilities.output: Comparable measures with explicit conditioning and units
capabilities.acceptance: Acquisition probability, conditional profit, joint target probability and per-attempt value are not conflated.

capabilities.input: Actual UI framework, narrow-screen and assistive-access needs, supported languages, keyboard behavior, and participant comprehension tasks
capabilities.output: Responsive interface and observed interaction evidence
capabilities.acceptance: Primary workflows are legible and operable at supported sizes and with assistive access; declared locales preserve currency/date meaning, and comprehension is tested with intended users. No undocumented language coverage or hidden decision blockers are claimed.

capabilities.input: Connected service, changed evidence, stale review, permissions
capabilities.output: UI replay and defect record for success and failure paths
capabilities.acceptance: The displayed result matches the actual service revision, and stale or unauthorized actions fail visibly.

steps: Start with the decision the operator needs to make and the evidence they must inspect.
Use engine/service results for calculations; keep the UI a transparent client.
Expose assumptions, missingness, conditioning and backend status beside results.
Verify the actual interaction, narrow layout, and stale-evidence behavior before claiming usability.
failure_modes: Embedding an independent financial formula in the browser.
Displaying an AI confidence score as a deal-success percentage.
Making unknown evidence look like a passing gate.
example_prompts: Build an offer comparison showing conditional and per-attempt returns clearly.
Create a document review screen that links every changed cost to its page.

skills.name: br-build-data-connectors
skills.description: Build authorized, traceable source connectors and deterministic normalization for Black River. Use for native file readers, registry/parcel feeds, source permissions, entity resolution, historical outcomes, incremental updates, and recoverable ingestion.
scope_now: Define source scope, identity, provenance, and deterministic fixture adapters.
Reuse existing connector authorization boundaries.
Keep live account and source access separate from local simulation.
scope_future: Add authorized Drive, registry, parcel, ledger and market-data connectors.
Scale incremental ingestion and entity-resolution review against verified source contracts.

capabilities.action: Define source access and permitted operations
capabilities.input: User authorization and participant consent where applicable, source contract, permitted purpose, fields, account or tenant scope, and retention requirements
capabilities.output: Read/write boundary, credential handling, retention and source manifest
capabilities.acceptance: Record permitted access and purpose before ingestion; support the applicable consent/retention boundary. A read-only task does not acquire write authority; secrets never enter source control or diagnostic output. Do not infer immigration or nationality from names to route financial decisions.

capabilities.action: Read structured files without semantic loss
capabilities.input: Native CSV/XLSX/JSON or other declared schema, source revision
capabilities.output: Typed candidate records and per-row import errors
capabilities.acceptance: Preserve original values, units, nulls and locations; malformed or unsupported cells remain errors rather than guessed values.

capabilities.action: Resolve deal and entity identity explicitly
capabilities.input: Parcel identifiers, owner names, LLC records, addresses and relationship evidence
capabilities.output: Candidate entity links with deterministic keys and review status
capabilities.acceptance: Ambiguous matches never merge automatically; provenance and historical owner/version context remain visible.

capabilities.input: Every offer version and accepted/rejected/expired/withdrawn/open/closed event
capabilities.output: Append-only outcome dataset with predictor-time cutoffs
capabilities.acceptance: Retain unsuccessful and pending cases; preserve related-deal grouping and avoid selection bias from successful-only ingestion.

capabilities.input: Source cursor or snapshot, hashes, retry state, schema revision
capabilities.output: Recoverable import batch with deduplication and change records
capabilities.acceptance: Replay does not duplicate claims; partial failure does not advance the source cursor beyond committed work.

capabilities.input: Upstream revisions, observed changes, transformation versions
capabilities.output: Migration and affected-evidence report
capabilities.acceptance: Changed schemas and source revisions cannot silently alter existing accepted inputs or historical model runs.

steps: Identify the authorized source and operation before accessing an account or endpoint.
Use deterministic native formats where available and preserve original field locations.
Normalize identity and time without merging ambiguous entities.
Commit bounded idempotent import batches and retain source/schema changes for replay.
failure_modes: Using a scrape as proof of ownership or authority.
Silently dropping failed offers from a training dataset.
Advancing an import cursor after only part of a batch commits.
example_prompts: Build a read-only rent-roll importer that preserves cell provenance.
Capture all offer outcomes for future calibration without leaking later facts.

skills.name: br-build-model-validation

scope_now: Reproduce important financial and evidence outcomes independently.
Test missing, contradictory, expired, malformed and boundary inputs.
Record source-reviewed versus executed versus unavailable paths.
scope_future: Build held-out field datasets, sustained monitoring and independently reviewed model approvals.
Expand validation for new strategies and live integrations.

capabilities.input: Requirements, current revision, model interfaces, risk scenarios
capabilities.output: Validation plan linking each material claim to evidence
capabilities.acceptance: Check actual product behavior, including a meaningful failure; avoid tests that merely repeat the implementation.

capabilities.input: Hand-worked examples, exact arithmetic, boundary conditions
capabilities.output: Known-answer cases and numerical discrepancy criteria
capabilities.acceptance: Cost bridges, terminal mass, chance thresholds and policy decisions reconcile without circularly reusing the same function.

capabilities.input: Malformed, wrong-deal, conflicting, stale, superseded and incomplete records
capabilities.output: Negative-case fixtures and observed blocking results
capabilities.acceptance: Unknown or invalid records cannot enter accepted-input projections or silently relax gates.

capabilities.input: CPU outputs, optional real CUDA and R results, typed interfaces

capabilities.acceptance: Unavailable hardware/runtime is an explicit limitation; no fallback or mocked execution is represented as a measured result.

capabilities.input: Imports, service configuration, network behavior, dependency list
capabilities.output: Demonstration that engine and application flows work without AI services
capabilities.acceptance: No LLM, NIM, autonomous-agent loop, or unapproved remote call is required by the default path.

capabilities.action: Publish the validation and gap register
capabilities.input: Focused checks, regression gates, runtime inventory, unresolved issues
capabilities.output: Versioned evidence report and next required validation gates
capabilities.acceptance: Separate implemented, executed, reviewed, deferred and unavailable; agent consensus never substitutes for evidence.

steps: Pin the source revision and identify material product claims.
Reproduce a positive case independently and challenge a concrete failure mode.
Verify the default non-AI path and actual backend behavior.
Record results and limits precisely; stop optional tests once the remaining identified risks are resolved.
failure_modes: Marking a skipped GPU/R check as passed.
Comparing an implementation with itself and calling it independent validation.
Converting reviewer agreement into financial confidence.
example_prompts: Validate the quote-to-underwriting path including conflicting and expired evidence.
Independently check the probability tree and its price-ceiling thresholds.

skills.name: br-build-ai-adapters
skills.display_name: Black River Future AI Adapter Builder
skills.description: Specify optional future AI and NVIDIA document-service adapters around the validated Black River product. Use for provider-neutral candidate-claim contracts, version compatibility, retrieval evaluation, and gated assistive AI design; never enable product AI merely by loading this skill.
scope_now: Define provider-neutral interfaces and explicit disabled/not-configured behavior.
Document version-specific NVIDIA service contracts.
Keep all AI outputs in candidate or explanatory roles.
scope_future: Deploy and evaluate extraction, embedding, reranking, and grounded explanations when authorized.
Consider bounded product agents only after separately validated capability, permissions and operating controls.

capabilities.input: Candidate-claim schema, source identity, error and timeout policies
capabilities.output: Provider interface with explicit manual/native and disabled-AI states
capabilities.acceptance: No model is installed, contacted, or made a runtime dependency just because the interface exists.

capabilities.action: Pin NVIDIA service and hardware compatibility
capabilities.input: Chosen NeMo Retriever/NIM/model versions, current official docs, actual GPU profile
capabilities.output: Compatibility matrix and deployment plan
capabilities.acceptance: Do not mix the newer Parse /v1/parse API with older VLM chat-completions examples; GPU/VRAM compatibility must be observed.

capabilities.action: Evaluate assisted extraction against labeled documents
capabilities.input: Authorized benchmark documents, human labels, source-locator contract
capabilities.output: Field accuracy, omission, numeric, layout and confidence-calibration results
capabilities.acceptance: Model outputs remain candidate claims; extraction score, evidence authority and deal-outcome probability stay separate.

capabilities.input: Authorized document collection, access metadata, query evaluation set
capabilities.output: Cited retrieval results with permission filtering and relevance evidence
capabilities.acceptance: Search cannot expose another scope's files; cited passages resolve to the exact document revision and location.

capabilities.action: Constrain assistive generation to accepted tools and evidence
capabilities.input: Reviewed facts, deterministic financial tools, user query, output schema
capabilities.output: Draft explanation or proposed change with references and explicit unknowns
capabilities.acceptance: Generated prose cannot overwrite canonical amounts, approve a transaction, or silently modify investment policy.

capabilities.action: Evaluate any later product-agent runtime separately
capabilities.input: Validated tools, task permissions, budgets, stop conditions, monitoring and rollback
capabilities.output: Separate proposal and acceptance evidence for bounded automation
capabilities.acceptance: Builder-agent configuration never grants product autonomy; runtime agents remain disabled until the separate phase is explicitly implemented and validated.

steps: Confirm that the requested work is an adapter design or an explicitly authorized later AI deployment.
Read current primary provider documentation and pin the service, model, client and hardware combination.
Accept only candidate claims or cited explanatory outputs through the existing review boundary.
Require separate quality, access, cost and operational evidence before enabling an AI service or runtime agent.
failure_modes: Putting NVIDIA model calls inside the financial core.
Copying an incompatible API from an older tutorial.
Treating a schema or feature flag as a deployed or validated AI capability.
example_prompts: Define a disabled Nemotron Parse adapter that emits candidate claims for later review.
Plan document retrieval and reranking without adding product agents yet.

skills.name: br-build-release-operations
skills.description: Package, configure, observe, and recover Black River product increments with accurate capability status. Use for reproducible releases, migrations, backups, runtime manifests, deployment gates, rollback, and operational monitoring.
scope_now: Run bounded release checks and record exact environment and artifacts.
Keep AI providers disabled by default.
Verify recoverable local state and document unavailable runtimes.
scope_future: Deploy authenticated services with measured service objectives.
Add capacity, cost, incident and model monitoring as real integrations become available.

capabilities.input: Source revision, schema versions, dependencies, backend/provider settings
capabilities.output: Reproducible package and example configuration
capabilities.acceptance: Default operation needs no AI keys; secrets are external; installed capabilities and optional dependencies are visible.

capabilities.action: Apply safe schema and data migrations
capabilities.input: Existing persistent state, migration version, rollback plan
capabilities.output: Atomic migration with compatibility and failure results
capabilities.acceptance: A failed migration preserves recoverable prior data; historical evidence and decisions are not silently rewritten.

capabilities.input: Evidence store, decision history, manifests and checksums
capabilities.output: Restored state and independently reproduced projection/run
capabilities.acceptance: Backup existence alone does not count as recovery; restored identifiers, records and balances reconcile.

capabilities.input: Execution logs, queue state, runtime metadata, document/page volume, review rate, retained versions, and resource/cost measurements
capabilities.output: Scoped operational events, cost per reviewed case, capacity/load model, and actionable exceptions
capabilities.acceptance: Logs omit secrets and private document bodies by default. Measure actual backend, queue latency, error/review rates, storage, throughput, and unit economics. A two-million-household capacity claim requires representative sustained load and cost evidence, not a row count or GPU-utilization percentage.

capabilities.action: Run release gates and document limitations
capabilities.input: Focused tests, existing required regression gates, environment inventory
capabilities.output: Release evidence and concrete rollback/recovery procedure
capabilities.acceptance: No unavailable R/CUDA/AI execution is claimed; failures stop the affected release path and remain explicitly described.

capabilities.input: Verified release, authorization, identity/storage/runtime requirements
capabilities.output: Capability-specific rollout and rollback record
capabilities.acceptance: Builder skills do not start production agents. Enable providers and external actions only within their implemented, authorized boundaries. Expand from a validated initial segment using observed participant value, unit economics, consent/accessibility coverage and measured capacity; no institutional-readiness or two-million-household claim follows from the prototype.

steps: Package only the actual implementation and make optional features explicit.
Run the required release gates plus tests that resolve identified remaining risks.
Verify state recovery and preserve source/model/runtime manifests.
Report what was delivered and what remains disabled or unavailable before any production enablement.
failure_modes: Calling a local script a hosted production deployment.
Treating an existing backup as a verified restore.
Enabling model services or external actions as a side effect of installing builder skills.
example_prompts: Prepare a reproducible release of the evidence and probability engines with AI disabled.
Verify restore and rollback before enabling a live document connector.

skills.name: br-coordinate-builder-resources
skills.description: Coordinate the Black River development swarm through a validated ticket DAG, bounded workers, critical-path estimates, file ownership, quality gates, and resource-aware roadmap reporting. Use to schedule builders and unblock development; this skill does not create product-runtime agents.
scope_now: Plan a maximum of three worker agents plus one reserved integrator.
Schedule dependency-ready tasks with explicit time estimates and write scopes.
Report GPU/R resource shortages and future AI deferrals.
scope_future: Integrate observed historical duration estimates after enough completed builds.
Evaluate additional build infrastructure only with demonstrated capacity and cost evidence.

capabilities.action: Maintain the dependency graph and ready queue
capabilities.input: Versioned tickets, dependencies, status, phase gates and observed blockers
capabilities.output: Validated DAG, topological order, ready/blocked/deferred sets
capabilities.acceptance: Reject missing dependencies and cycles; completed prerequisites satisfy dependencies and deferred/blocked work cannot become ready.

capabilities.action: Allocate bounded builder and execution resources
capabilities.input: Ready tickets, three worker slots, reserved integrator, actual CUDA/R availability
capabilities.output: Feasible resource allocation with explicit shortage reasons
capabilities.acceptance: Never allocate more than three parallel workers and one integrator; zero CUDA or R capacity blocks tickets requiring those runtimes.

capabilities.action: Schedule critical work with visible estimates
capabilities.input: DAG, assumption-based duration estimates, priorities and resource capacities
capabilities.output: Relative start/finish schedule, critical-path priority and estimated completion range
capabilities.acceptance: Durations are labeled planning assumptions; estimates never become promised dates or fabricated performance measurements.

capabilities.input: Ticket write scopes, shared files, assignment and integration plan
capabilities.output: Conflict-free work assignments and serialized shared-file edits
capabilities.acceptance: Overlapping file or ancestor-directory write scopes cannot run concurrently; no builder may overwrite another's unintegrated work.

capabilities.action: Enforce quality, rework and handoff gates
capabilities.input: Acceptance criteria, validation evidence, failed checks and review findings
capabilities.output: Completed/returned-for-rework/blocked handoffs with named ownership
capabilities.acceptance: A task becomes completed only after its own evidence is reviewed; rework preserves failure history and invalidates affected downstream assumptions.

capabilities.input: Scheduled waves, implemented evidence, unmet dependencies, unavailable runtimes
capabilities.output: Roadmap by phase and status with the next feasible work
capabilities.acceptance: Distinguish plan, active builders and actual runtime deployment; disclose AI deferral and resource shortages instead of pretending the full roadmap is complete.

steps: Validate ticket IDs, dependencies, phase gates, acceptance criteria and estimates.
Reserve the integrator and allocate ready work within the observed worker and runtime capacities.
Serialize overlapping write scopes, prioritize critical work, and record handoffs or rework.
Recompute the plan when status or resources change and report estimated rather than promised completion.
failure_modes: Treating the development scheduler as an autonomous product-agent runtime.
Assigning tasks that require a GPU/R runtime when capacity is zero.
Parallelizing overlapping write scopes or marking work complete from agent self-report alone.
example_prompts: Schedule the builder swarm for the document engine with three workers and one integrator.
Show the next ready tickets, critical path, and GPU/R work blocked by unavailable resources.
